# Pages named .mdx are pages like any other: a static build renders
# them, links to them are rewritten, and the server serves them.

md2html -html out -nav -search src
exists out/index.html
exists out/guide.html
exists out/api/client.html
grep -q 'Guide body' out/guide.html
grep -q 'Client body' out/api/client.html
! exists out/guide.mdx.html

# index.mdx is the site index, so no listing replaces it.
grep -q 'Home body' out/index.html
! grep -q 'Index of /' out/index.html

# Links to .mdx pages name the rendered pages.
grep -q 'href="guide.html"' out/index.html
grep -q 'href="api/client.html#usage"' out/index.html
grep -q 'href="../guide.html"' out/api/client.html

# The navigation lists them.
grep -q 'The Guide' out/index.html

# The server renders an .mdx page rather than sending its source.
cd src
md2html -search -http :9141 &
wait-port :9141
curl -s http://localhost:9141/guide
stdout '<h1[^>]*>The Guide</h1>'
stdout 'Guide body'
curl -s http://localhost:9141/guide.mdx
stdout 'Guide body'
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'
curl -s http://localhost:9141/
stdout 'Home body'

# The search index covers them, under their rendered URLs.
curl -s http://localhost:9141/search-index.js
stdout '"title":"The Guide"'
stdout '"url":"/api/client"'
! stdout 'client\.mdx'

-- src/index.mdx --
---
title: Home
---

Home body. See the [guide](guide.mdx) and the
[client](api/client.mdx#usage).
-- src/guide.mdx --
---
title: The Guide
---

# The Guide

Guide body.
-- src/api/client.mdx --
# Client

## Usage

Client body. Back to the [guide](../guide.mdx).
